Generate new 1024x1536 portrait PURE ILLUSTRATION. Only these two supplied reference images establish commercial Chinese fantasy collectible card illustration STYLE, not pose or costume. Low-rarity early Guan Yu, mature phoenix eyes, magnificent long dark beard, plain worn green cloth headwrap and green civilian wrap robe, no armor or weapon. IMPORTANT STORY: he earns his humble living selling green mung beans while remaining deeply concerned with the suffering and affairs of the wider world. NOT an indifferent shopkeeper, not looking down at beans. Face is FIRST focal point, expressive intelligent concerned eyes, brows drawn with restrained compassion and moral resolve, a chivalrous hero still hidden in ordinary life. His attention and gaze must visibly connect to the external story cue.
NONREALISTIC drawn comic warrior design, sculptural dimensional planes, smooth clean face shading NO pores, anime-influenced facial construction, grouped beard locks and LARGE simplified robe folds, polished commercial game-card art. No photo or movie realism, no patchy oil paint. Bright readable main character and face against restrained blue-dark illustrated street. An unmistakable wooden MUNG BEAN stall, baskets and sacks full of small GREEN mung beans, measuring utensils, simple worn cloth canopy. All supporting characters visually secondary. Complete headwrap remains below y160 with background headroom. No text, lettering, UI or border. No crowns, armor, weapons, horses. Optional spirit: only a tiny extremely thin faint cyan-green serpentine stroke, maximum 3% contrast, in remote background, no dragon head or full body.
SPECIFIC STORY AND COMPOSITION: WIDE FULL FIGURE, three-quarter elevated viewpoint across the bean stall edge. Guan Yu crouches beside a large basket of green mung beans at the FRONT of his stall, one hand steadying its rim, other resting on bent knee. He has stopped working and LIFTED HIS HEAD to watch a displaced mother guiding a small child along the street on the right. The mother and child are small secondary BACK VIEWS with plain travel bundles, moving away; not looking at camera, no graphic distress. Guan Yu's face in clear three-quarter view looks UP and right toward them with pained compassion and silent resolve, never down at beans. Main figure occupies lower middle, full crouched body and feet, head around y500. Market canopy and cool street above. Strong narrative diagonal from his concerned eyes to travelers. Do not make him grin or aggressively glare.
